parameters.brief: Preparing a normalized streaming loop and a correctly encoded listening copy of the generated music.
parameters.content:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, json, hashlib
import numpy as np
root=Path.cwd();out=Path('/home/ubuntu/comet-pinball-cosmic')
source=out/'Comet-Pinball-Celestial-Drift-master.wav'
rate=44100
raw=subprocess.check_output(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-i',str(source),'-f','f32le','-ac','2','-ar',str(rate),'-'])
samples=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1,2).copy()
# Trim only negligible silent padding, not musical content.
activity=np.max(np.abs(samples),axis=1)
active=np.flatnonzero(activity>0.001)
start=max(0,int(active[0])-round(rate*0.04)) if active.size else 0
end=min(len(samples),int(active[-1])+round(rate*0.04)) if active.size else len(samples)
x=samples[start:end]
fade=round(rate*1.25)
u=np.linspace(0,1,fade,dtype=np.float32)[:,None]
# The next repetition starts at x[fade], directly after the completed head fade.
blend=x[-fade:]*(1-u)+x[:fade]*u
loop=np.concatenate([x[fade:-fade],blend])
raw_loop=root/'dist/celestial-drift-loop.f32';raw_loop.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
raw_loop.write_bytes(loop.astype(np.float32).tobytes())
ogg=root/'assets/audio/cosmic/celestial-drift.ogg'
listening=out/'Comet-Pinball-Celestial-Drift.mp3'
base=['ffmpeg','-y','-v','error','-f','f32le','-ar',str(rate),'-ac','2','-i',str(raw_loop),'-af','loudnorm=I=-19:TP=-2:LRA=9','-ar',str(rate)]
subprocess.run(base+['-c:a','libvorbis','-q:a','4',str(ogg)],check=True)
subprocess.run(base+['-c:a','libmp3lame','-b:a','192k',str(listening)],check=True)
report={'source_codec':'mp3 (as reported by ffprobe; generator named the file .wav)','source_duration_seconds':len(samples)/rate,'loop_duration_seconds':len(loop)/rate,'trim_start_seconds':start/rate,'trim_end_seconds':(len(samples)-end)/rate,'crossfade_seconds':fade/rate,'source_peak':float(np.max(np.abs(samples))),'source_rms':float(np.sqrt(np.mean(samples**2))),'pre_encode_seam_step':float(np.max(np.abs(loop[-1]-loop[0]))),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'output_bytes':ogg.stat().st_size}
(root/'dist/cosmic-audio-analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
# A new file preserves the old asset until integration and validation complete.
p=root/'scripts/comet_main.gd';s=p.read_text().replace('res://assets/audio/combat/combat.ogg','res://assets/audio/cosmic/celestial-drift.ogg');p.write_text(s)
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print('LISTENING COPY',listening)
